mapper.select: SELECT a.*, a_t.article_tag_name from article as a LEFT JOIN article_tag_list on a.article_id = article_tag_list.article_id left JOIN article_tag as a_t on a_t.article_tag_id = article_tag_list.tag_id;

SELECT a.*, a_t.article_tag_name from article as a LEFT JOIN article_tag_list on a.article_id = article_tag_list.article_id left JOIN article_tag as a_t on a_t.article_tag_id = article_tag_list.tag_id where a.article_id = #{articleId}

SELECT a.*, a_t.article_tag_name from (select * from article limit #{start},#{num}) as a LEFT JOIN article_tag_list on a.article_id = article_tag_list.article_id left JOIN article_tag as a_t on a_t.article_tag_id = article_tag_list.tag_id
SELECT a_t.article_tag_name from article_tag as a_t join article_tag_list as list on a_t.article_tag_id = list.tag_id where article_id = #{articleId};

SELECT a.*, t.article_tag_name FROM article a LEFT JOIN article_tag_list at ON a.article_id = at.article_id LEFT JOIN article_tag t ON at.tag_id = t.article_tag_id WHERE a.article_id IN
#{id}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.article_id) FROM article a LEFT JOIN article_tag_list at ON a.article_id = at.article_id LEFT JOIN article_tag t ON at.tag_id = t.article_tag_id WHERE 1=1
AND (a.article_title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR t.article_tag_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
